name: Llavorsí (Spain)
description: Red field with a white wavy Y (pall) lying horizontally with its forked arms at the hoist corners and its trunk running to the fly.
history: The official flag of Llavorsí is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a white Y of wavy arms of 4 waves in the forks and 8 in the trunk, of thickness 1/6 of the height of the cloth, placed horizontally with the forked arms at the hoist corners; approved on 21 November 2006 and published in the DOGC on 14 December 2006.

features.role: wavy pall lying horizontally, forked towards the hoist corners
